items.content:
Hwaseong, South Korea, past midnight. An engineer watches a defect pattern surface on her screen – the kind that, caught now, saves a week of wafers. She is locked in, fully absorbed, the way engineers get when a breakthrough is close. But she has to go home. The law says so.
Yet something is disrupting the clock she races against. Artificial intelligence is quietly rewriting what her hours are worth.
